name: RTI-371
summary: 3β-(4-Methylphenyl)-2β-[3-(4-chlorophenyl)isoxazol-5-yl]tropane (RTI-4229-371) is a phenyltropane derived drug which acts as a potent and selective dopamine reuptake inhibitor in vitro, yet unusually for this class of compound, both RTI-371 and the closely related compound RTI-370 failed to produce locomotor stimulation in mice.

pharmacology.text: 3β-(4-Methylphenyl)-2β-[3-(4-chlorophenyl)isoxazol-5-yl]tropane (RTI-4229-371) is a phenyltropane derived drug which acts as a potent and selective dopamine reuptake inhibitor in vitro, yet unusually for this class of compound, both RTI-371 and the closely related compound RTI-370 failed to produce locomotor stimulation in mice.

uses.en: It is used only in laboratory research and is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它僅用於實驗室研究，並不是藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它仅用于实验室研究，并不是药物。

fact.en: RTI-371 binds the dopamine transporter at a site that differs from cocaine's, and in animals it does not produce the stimulant effects the rest of the series does.
fact.zh: RTI-371 結合多巴胺轉運蛋白的位點與古柯鹼不同，在動物身上它也不會產生系列中其他化合物的興奮作用。
fact.zhHans: RTI-371 结合多巴胺转运蛋白的位点与古柯碱不同，在动物身上它也不会产生系列中其他化合物的兴奋作用。
